provenance.how: Each changelog was downloaded whole; each entry is one of its bullets byte for byte without the leading '- ', and copilot-cli-changelog.md is its text from the 1.0.103 heading up to the 1.0.100 heading.

flag-after-a-slash.entry: Improve remote launch options with clearer hosting/connection flags and retire legacy --remote/--no-remote startup flags

short-flag-after-a-slash.entry: `--append-system-prompt` can now be used in interactive mode, not just --print/-p.

flag-in-parentheses-and-flag-with-a-valu.entry: Print mode (-p) now supports streaming output via --output-format=stream-json

flag-in-a-code-span.entry: Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with `--mcp-config`

flag-with-a-value-in-a-code-span.entry: A relative `--add-dir` or `--plugin-dir` path now resolves against the session's working directory under `--resume=<id>` and `--worktree`, instead of the directory the CLI was launched from. Relative values are also resolved after `-C` is applied, so `-C` no longer has to precede either option on the command line

flag-inside-a-longer-flag.entry: Skills and custom agents from --plugin-dir plugins now reach autocomplete and invocation instead of going missing.

variables-as-words.entry: Sandboxed network traffic now honors NO_PROXY and ALL_PROXY when inheriting host proxy settings

variable-and-path-as-words.entry: COPILOT_HOME and --config-dir stop loading skills from ~/.agents/skills

one-word-variable-in-a-code-span.entry: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` is set (a 2.1.300 regression)

one-word-variable-after-a-dollar.entry: Fixed Bash deny and ask rules missing a command behind an environment variable prefix with an expanded value (e.g. `TZ="$HOME" rm -rf build`) when the sandbox auto-allows commands

one-word-variable-in-braces.entry: Fixed MCP connection errors and the MCP login tool's description showing secrets resolved from `${VAR}` placeholders in MCP configs

path-in-a-code-span.entry: Fixed project skills from the main repository not loading in `--worktree` sessions when `.claude/skills` is untracked

path-split-by-a-parenthesis.entry: --plugin-dir skills now take precedence over personal-home (~/.copilot, ~/.agents) skills with the same name. Order is now project > plugin-dir > personal > custom.

hyphenated-key-in-a-code-span.entry: A skill `allowed-tools` rule keeps commas inside its arguments instead of being split apart. Where a list's structure is ambiguous, its unscoped rules now prompt instead of being granted.

one-word-key-in-a-code-span.entry: Fixed agent hooks ignoring their `model`: aliases like `haiku` now resolve, a subagent's model no longer overrides it, and an unavailable model falls back to the caller's instead of allowing the action

one-word-key-as-a-word.entry: Model picker marks your administrator-managed model as the default when it is available
